values.note: $30 a night for a single site (recreation.gov peak season, the same in 2026, 2027 and 2028). Day use $10 a vehicle. An extra-vehicle fee applies after the second vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-09 to 2026-10-12, 2027-05-09 to 2027-10-12 and 2028: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' 30) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/nichols-lake-south-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Day Use: $10 per vehicle per day'; last updated September 17, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845 (notice 'An extra vehicle fee applies after the 2nd vehicle on single sites'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 251845 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (all 28 sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 29 family sites on paved spurs (the catalog lists 28, 10 reservable and 18 first-come); all back-in. Catalog lengths, given only for the reservable sites, run 35-65 ft. Two vehicles and two camping units per site, only one of them wheeled; all tires must fit on the spur.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845 ('Nichols Lake has 29 family sites on paved spurs'; notices 'Site capacities are: 2 vehicles, 2 camping units, only one can be wheeled', 'All tires need to fit on the spurs!') + RIDB campsite catalog for 251845 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (28 sites, all 'Back-In'; Max Vehicle Length 35-65 on the 10 reservable sites), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845 ('Drinking water, flush toilets, and showers are provided') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/nichols-lake-south-campground ('Restrooms: Flush toilet(s) and vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/nichols-lake-south-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Early May - Mid October'; status 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-25), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 4 days before arrival; 18 of the 28 catalog sites are first-come. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845 (facility_rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notices 'Some single sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Check in time is 2:00pm and Check out time is 11:00am', 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.Huron.Manistee@AmericanLL.com') + RIDB campsite catalog for 251845 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (18 sites not reservable), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes give 50% off single campsites only (the site the pass holder occupies); enter the pass at booking.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/nichols-lake-south-campground ('Interagency Senior and Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites only') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251845 ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-25

note: Manistee NF campground on the south side of 160-acre Nichols Lake, 4.5 mi W of M-37 on 11 Mile Road (13.5 mi S of Baldwin). A wood ramp and stairs lead down to the lake; lakeside fishing path, paved boat launch, buoyed swim beach (no lifeguards) and accessible fishing pier. The North Country Trail passes the boat ramp; a separate day-use area is on the north side of the lake. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB catalog + FS page (updated 2026-09-17): $30 single (2026-2028, confirmed), no electric (confirmed), 29 sites (confirmed) all back-in, 35-65 ft (new), flush and vault toilets, showers, drinking water (confirmed + vault new), reservable on rec.gov (confirmed) with 18 first-come sites, 4-day cutoff, senior/access 50% off; season early May - mid October (FS 'Site Closed' now, past its season). Water/sewer left as derived false (catalog silent). No min stay rule. No Huron-Manistee alert or order affects the campground or 11 Mile Road (the page's only active alert is the NCT pack-animal/bicycle order). Note trimmed of field restatements.
